The '''Tactical Training Facility''' was a facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that was the site of multiple skirmishes between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:TacticalTrainingFacility2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Tactical Training Facility would often change hands between Imperial and Rebel forces.]]
Located at the foot of the [[Dregan's Pike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the Tactical Training Facility was a military base contested between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Restuss]],<ref name="SWG:C1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Chapter 1: The Battle for Restuss</ref><ref name="GalaxyAtWar">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66909&resource=features|text=''A Galaxy At War''}}</ref> the facility was the site of regular fighting between both factions.<ref name="SWG:C2" /><ref name="GalaxyAtWar" /> Each faction would vie for control of the facility by securing each of its four terminals, codenamed Alpha, Beta, Delta, and Gamma.<ref name="SWG:C2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tactical Training Facility appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:C2" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Tactical Training Facility was added to the game with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref> It was one of the three main base's that players of each faction could capture, along with the [[Weapons Development Facility|Naboo Weapons Development Facility]] and the [[Weapons Depot|Talus Weapons Depot]].<ref name="SWG:C2" />
